text:
sophia: Heads-up — found a dead link in the onboarding KB (runtime section). Clicking the 'KV cache troubleshooting' anchor goes to a 404.
aj: thanks. can you paste the exact URL?
sophia: https://kb.redwood.ai/runtime/kv-cache-troubleshooting returns 404. also this embedded image is 403: https://cdn.redwood.com/runbook/kv-cache.png
sophia: repro: open /kb/runtime/caching and click the 'kv cache troubleshooting' link.
leo: noted. is this affecting any customer-facing runbooks or just internal onboarding?
sophia: internal KB + onboarding playbook used by SEs. low severity but annoying.
matt: if it's just an image 403 we can rehost in our docs-assets bucket and update the markdown quickly.
sophia: planning to open a tiny PR to rehost the image and swap the link. pinging owners for review.
leo: I can pick this up if no one else.
aj: thanks @leo — can you also update the frontmatter to include docs-owner so it's routed properly? add `docs-owner: eng-runtime`.
matt: quick sed workflow suggestion: find the pages referencing the anchor, replace the URL, and update alt text. example commands:```bash
git grep -l "kv-cache-troubleshooting" docs/ | xargs -I{} sed -i "s|https://cdn.redwood.com/runbook/kv-cache.png|/assets/docs/kv-cache.png|g" {}
```
leo: creating branch `docs/kv-cache-image-fix` now. will rehost image to s3://docs-assets/redwood/kv-cache.png and push. PR coming shortly.
sophia: thanks. can you include a short note in the PR description about why we rehost (CDN auth expired).
leo: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4987 — includes frontmatter change `docs-owner: eng-runtime`.
jamie: I can review in ~2 hours. putting it on my queue.
deploy-bot: preview available: https://deploy.preview.redwood/changes/4987 (staging rendering shows image ok).
matt: small nit: update the image alt text to `kv cache diagram` and add a one-line caption mentioning which service owns the diagram.
leo: updated alt + caption in the PR. also added a short test checklist entry for the KB lint job.
jamie: LGTM :thumbsup: no content changes beyond docs-owner and image path. merging once CI green.
sophia: super, thanks y'all. will notify SEs about the fix after merge.
aj: quick follow-up — can we add a tiny CI check to flag external-cdn 403s in the next sprint? filing a ticket after this.
sophia: noted, thanks!
